description: Header file defining the MediaPlayerService class and related classes for Android's media framework, including nested classes for AudioOutput and AudioCache, and interface declarations for media playback and battery usage tracking.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService
classes.description: Main service class for media playback, managing clients, media recorders, and battery usage data.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService::AudioOutput
classes.description: Handles audio output streams for media playback.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService::AudioCache
classes.description: Provides cached audio sink for media playback.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService::Client
classes.description: Represents a media client connected to the service, managing individual media playback sessions.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService::BatteryUsageInfo
classes.description: Tracks battery usage statistics for media streams.

classes.name: MediaPlayerService::BatteryAudioFlingerUsageInfo
classes.description: Tracks audio output device usage for battery statistics.

methods.name: AudioOutput::open
methods.description: Opens an audio output stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: AudioOutput::setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio output.

methods.name: AudioOutput::setPlaybackRatePermille
methods.description: Sets the playback rate in permille.

methods.name: AudioCache::open
methods.description: Opens an audio cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: addBatteryData
methods.description: Collects battery usage data for media codecs.

methods.name: pullBatteryData
methods.description: Retrieves battery usage data for media codecs.
